tonight.title: The Odyssey
tonight.why: For a truly unsettling Friday night, 'Other Mommy' promises to crawl under your skin with its chilling premise of a doppelgänger entity. Prepare for a sleepless night as young Bela's world descends into a terrifying mimicry of familial horror.

releases.title: Other Mommy
releases.take: If your mom suddenly starts looking like a horror movie villain, maybe it's time to call an exorcist, or at least move out.

releases.title: Avengers: Doomsday
releases.take: Three universes, one problem: too many capes, not enough common sense, but definitely enough explosions to go around.

releases.title: The Beast
releases.take: When the Secret Service budget runs dry, apparently the President just drives his armored limo into battle himself.

critic.title: The Odyssey
critic.blurb: For those craving a narrative with epic scope and timeless themes, 'The Odyssey' offers a journey of mythic proportions. It's a foundational tale of human resilience, cunning, and the enduring quest for home, proving that some stories never age.
